rationale: S-0002-01 proposes a factorial (g_Na, g_K) grid search on a DSGC compartmental model to locate the DSI-maximising conductance ridge — the canonical RQ1 experiment. Pre-shunting-discovery framing. t0065 / t0066 demonstrated cross-model convergence on e_GABA = v_rest = -60 mV producing pure shunting inhibition, and t0067 showed that adding individual voltage-gated channels to the soma either erodes (Nav1.6) or inverts (NaP) DSI without rescuing it; the inhibition / excitation conductance ratio dominates the DSI mechanism, not the somatic VGC repertoire. The factorial g_Na x g_K sweep remains a useful follow-up once the e_GABA hypothesis is settled and a working multi-spike substrate exists, but is no longer top-of-queue. Reprioritising from high to medium so the high-priority shelf reflects the post-shunting-discovery critical path.
